name: Gridlock
tag: Draw the roads of a growing town and keep the traffic flowing
title: Gridlock

text.TAG: Draw the roads of a growing town. Get every car from home to work and back before the traffic grinds to a halt
text.FREE: Anything goes: unlimited roads, bridges, tunnels, motorways and roundabouts, and no game over
text.WATCH: A tour of busy towns: rivers, mountains, motorways and rush-hour traffic
text.FOOT: Cars only visit buildings of their own colour. Every week you get more road and choose an upgrade. If a building waits too long, the town gives up.
text.FIND: Find a building, colour or upgrade…
text.HINT: Drag to paint roads · right-drag to look around
